import json, random, sys

def build(seed=7, natoms=20, K=4, ntrain=4096, nprobe=128, nquery=1024, nsrc=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    fields = [{"name":"bytes","type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":100000},
              {"name":"packets","type":"COUNT","min":0,"max":10000}]
    atoms=[]
    for i in range(natoms):
        f = fields[i % 2]
        atoms.append({"cmp":"ge","left":{"field":f["name"],"at":i%K},"right":{"const":rng.randint(100,900),"type":f["type"]}})
    def trace(tid, src, nrows):
        rows=[]; t=0
        for i in range(nrows):
            rows.append({"t":t,"values":[rng.randint(0,1000), rng.randint(0,100)]})
            t+=1
        return {"id":tid,"source":src,"rows":rows}
    def part(prefix, target, ntraces, nsources):
        out=[]; made=0
        for i in range(ntraces):
            want = target - made
            nctx = max(1, want // (ntraces - i))
            out.append(trace("%s%d"%(prefix,i), "s%d"%(i%nsources), nctx+K-1))
            made += nctx
        return out
    return {"version":1,"schema":fields,"window":K,"atoms":atoms,
            "policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":2,"min_witness":2},
            "train":part("t", ntrain, 4, nsrc),
            "probes":part("p", nprobe, 2, 1),
            "queries":part("q", nquery, 2, 1)}

if __name__=="__main__":
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(build()))
PYEOF
